method: N3 evaluated guard/peak shapes rebased; U/F/T topology preserved, key schedules replaced. Added 60 mm anchored lateral routing bow consistently to U/F layers and feeds (68 mm total including N3). Root X pitch around shoulder ring centroid with strike trims. Glove constrained to evaluated wrist core; no shoulder-to-wrist endpoint lengthening.
limitations: Short 50% uses shape extrapolation; not a material strain/arc constraint solution. Routing bow changes arc length and lateral envelope.
Preset switches are chapter cuts; no claim of transition collision clearance.
Hidden manifold/anchor does not constitute designed pitch hardware.
